name: printing-press-youtube-cli
description: Agent-native social CLI harness, starting with YouTube.

scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs --help && node src/cli.mjs profile list --json && node src/cli.mjs post youtube --profile smoke --post-type video --text "hello" --media test/fixtures/sample.mp4 --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs post youtube --profile smoke --post-type short --text "short" --media test/fixtures/sample.mp4 --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs comment youtube --profile smoke --url https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=123 --text "nice" --dry-run --json
